dispositions.idea: Topology/degree/metapath gate that selects or fuses members
dispositions.reason: Ordinary MoE routing is excluded; retained CHoE, MoE-NP, GraphMoRE, MORGAN and Link-MoE already supply close graph-conditioned routing ingredients.

dispositions.idea: Different walk lengths or graph masks for each member plus uniform averaging
dispositions.reason: Retained FAGEL/GRAND/graph-diversity work and new GPM/CHAT already cover diversified sampling, multi-scale contexts and view averaging. A fixed structural bank for a capable single is needed before crediting member learning.

dispositions.idea: Auxiliary observation-pattern likelihood or motif reconstruction
dispositions.reason: The frozen NCNC J/F and existing GRAN/MaskGAE/joint-pattern memory already investigate structural observation supervision. This packet neither duplicates nor modifies them.

dispositions.idea: Learned structural intervention with private response preservation
dispositions.reason: Saved conditional graph-response, CF-GNNExplainer, AD-GCL and spectral/edge-augmentation scopes already retain that question; changing a mask name would repeat existing work.
sMCL directly supplies training assignment and emergent specialization. Oracle loss/accuracy is not uniform served-pool quality, so oracle improvement cannot justify this project's prediction claim.

dispositions.idea: Create separate experts for frequent/rare link histories
dispositions.reason: New TAMI identifies missing/skewed temporal evidence and fixes it inside one learner. A history-capable single must be tested before treating the issue as an ensemble gap; temporal causal state is also absent from the frozen static pipeline.

dispositions.idea: TRAIN-topology-conditioned private risk allocation with native shared-body supervision
dispositions.reason: This is a distinct full-training assignment rule, but it combines established conditional reweighting, specialist training and block-dependent gradients. No inspected scope supplies a quality guarantee, and arbitrary structural cells/anchor, shared-body interference and capable-single parity remain concrete weaknesses. No source preparation or fit is recommended by this packet.

null_finding_scope: This bounded primary pass did not produce a new supported quality mechanism ready for implementation; it does not rule out every structure-conditioned shared ensemble.
closest_complete_learning_ancestor: sMCL winner-take-gradient; a topology-based assignment changes the criterion and the shared/private treatment, rather than creating specialization itself.
closest_capable_graph_comparator: GPM single with the same topology/pattern information under harmonized roles; existing BUDDY/LPFormer structural singles remain applicable to Collab.
